name: Sovereign Dragon, Very Young
body:
This magnificent dragon is covered in splendid gold scales, and horns jut from its head like a crown.

Very Young Sovereign Dragon
CR 9

XP 6,400
N Medium dragon
Init +5; Senses dragon senses; Perception +16

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 11, flat-footed 20 (+1 Dex, +10 natural)
hp 95 (10d12+30)
Fort +10, Ref +10, Will +12
Immune paralysis, sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)
Melee bite +16 (1d8+7), 2 claws +15 (1d6+5), gore +15 (1d6+7)
Special Attacks breath weapon (30 ft. cone, 4d6 sonic, DC 18)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th; concentration +13)

At will—detect evil/good

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 12, Con 17, Int 16, Wis 17, Cha 16
Base Atk +10; CMB +15; CMD 26 (30 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Persuasive, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Appraise +16, Bluff +16, Diplomacy +20, Fly +1, Intimidate +20, Knowledge (arcana, history) +16, Perception +16, Sense Motive +16, Spellcraft +16
Languages Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal
SQ dogmatic discordance

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dogmatic Discordance (Su)

Good or evil creatures take a -2 penalty when making saving throws against a sovereign dragon’s spells, spell-like abilities, breath weapon, and aura.

ECOLOGY

Environment any mountains
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

Guardians of balance, sovereign dragons, or lungwangs as they are also known, were placed in the skies by the gods themselves to safeguard harmony in the world.
